newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Jan 30.

text.p: Victor Co of Japan Ltd plans to market digital video disc (DVD) player and six disc titles on April 21. It will also start disc production in Japan.

Japan Telecom Co Ltd is expecting to increase its pre-tax profit by 15 percent to 48 billion yen in the year to March 31, helped by lower access fees for using the telephone circuits of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp.

Japan's big three personal computer (PC) makers -- NEC Corp, Fujitsu Ltd and IBM Japan Ltd -- forecast that PC shipments in Japan will rise by about 20 percent to nine million in the business year starting on April 1. NEC targets shipments of 4.75 million PCs, Fujitsu hopes to ship nearly 2.9 million and IBM Japan about 1.3 million.

Mitsuba Corp, affiliated with Honda Motor Co Ltd, is expecting to see its pre-tax profit rise by 30 percent to around 3.6 billion yen in the business year to March 31, helped by a five percent increase in sales to Honda on the back of healthy demand for recreational vehicles.
